item.title: Houthis hit Riyadh’s tallest skyscraper in strike on Saudi wealth fund HQ
item.description: Riyadh’s tallest skyscraper, headquarters of the Saudi sovereign wealth fund, was struck on Thursday by a suspected Houthi missile in the latest blow in the Iran-backed Yemeni group’s war with the kingdom. The strike blew out windows across seven to eight floors of PIF Tower, bending parts of its metal facade. It was the second time in less than two weeks that a Houthi attack damaged a landmark in ‌Riyadh’s financial district, with state oil giant Aramco’s building hit in a November 8... item.title: Utah restored or improved 128,232 acres across 110 habitat projects in a year
item.description: In the financial year 2025–26, Utah successfully restored over 128,000 acres through its innovative Watershed Restoration Initiative. The program involved reseeding, improving waterways, and safeguarding sagebrush habitats, greatly aiding local wildlife. With collaboration from over 63 partners who contributed upwards of $43 million, the initiative not only fostered environmental restoration but also created around 748 jobs, significantly benefiting local economies and enhancing nearly 3 million acres of land overall. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: APEC Summit: Lots of gloss, little real progress?
item.description: Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin are holding their first-ever trilateral meeting in Shenzhen, on the sidelines of the APEC forum. It is a historic moment in more ways than one, with the leaders of the world’s three most powerful countries around the same table. Ukraine, the war in Iran, nuclear disarmament and artificial intelligence are all expected to be discussed, and the summit has stoked fears of a carve-up of the world into spheres of influence.
